snippet.title: On Any Journey - Teaser 1.0
snippet.description:
New Trailer：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B4GtcehQeoA

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

💥 Wishlist On Any Journey on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201370/ON_ANY_JOURNEY/

💥Talk with us on Discord:  https://discord.com/invite/5W6mxbVfh7

🎮 Description:
On Any Journey is an immersive co-op adventure game crafted for two players by Funbrew Games.
It demands seamless teamwork and creative problem-solving, blending vibrant visual styles with thrilling cooperative puzzles for a truly shared adventure.

Embark on an unforgettable quest, where you’ll meet the enigmatic magician Bruno, the mysterious mask-wearing Pooka clan, and a colossal rockstar ruling the ocean depths. 
Yet every great story needs a formidable foe—enter Big Man and his relentless guards, determined to thwart your path.

Face tough choices and exhilarating challenges as confidence battles self-doubt and destiny tests your resolve. 
When the journey ends, will you stay true to yourself, or yield to the fate that seeks to shape you?
